name: Follower Bowling
description: Your ten newest followers get racked as pins. Chat types !bowl to get in line, first come first served, and the lane sends the next one down every fifteen seconds. A full-screen scene for when you are away from the keyboard: put it on its own OBS scene and it runs itself. Installs the lane overlay, the queue List and the !bowl command. You switch the bot on and put the overlay in OBS.
changelog: Initial release. The second listed product, and the first to install a List and a chat command.
hero_alt: Follower Bowling on stream: a bowling ball rolls at ten pins, each named after one of the channel's newest followers
ready_message: Your chat can type !bowl right now. Switch to the lane's scene in OBS and it runs itself.
highlights: Your ten newest Twitch followers are the pins, with their avatars and names.
!bowl puts a Twitch viewer in line, first come first served. The lane sends the next one down every fifteen seconds by itself.
Ball, pins and score play out on the overlay. A strike says STRIKE.

pitch.tagline: Your newest followers become bowling pins.
pitch.lede: Your ten newest followers are racked up as pins, with their avatars and names. Chat types `!bowl` to get in line, first come first served, and the lane rolls the next viewer down every fifteen seconds.

plays.title: Chat gets in line
plays.line: One `!bowl` and you are in the queue.

plays.title: The ball rolls by itself
plays.line: Every fifteen seconds, the next viewer bowls.

art.alt: A ball rolling down a bowling lane towards ten pins

plays.title: Pins fall, the score shows
plays.line: A strike says STRIKE. A gutter says GUTTER.

pitch.reasons_heading: A bowling lane made of your followers.

reasons.title: New followers get a moment
reasons.body: Following your channel puts someone on your stream as a pin, with their avatar and name.

reasons.title: It runs itself
reasons.body: It bowls every fifteen seconds while there's a line. Nobody has to call the next bowler.

reasons.title: A scene for your break
reasons.body: The lane fills the screen. Put it on its own OBS scene for when you are away, and switch to it whenever you like.

reasons.title: First come, first served
reasons.body: One `!bowl` and you are in line. Everyone gets one spot, and the line goes in the order chat joined it.

pitch.looks_lede: Pick one in the designer, then change any of the six colors, the lane included, to match your stream.
pitch.setup_note: Put the lane on its own scene in OBS, for your break or downtime. It runs itself whenever someone is in line.

faq.a: Your ten newest followers, with their avatars and names.

faq.q: Does the bot fill chat with messages?
faq.a: No. While the lane runs, the bot stays quiet. The score is on the overlay.
Whoever typed `!bowl` first. One spot per viewer, and the line goes in order.

faq.q: Do my viewers need to sign up for anything?
faq.a: No. They type in your Twitch chat, like any other chat command.

notes: The lane runs itself. Whenever someone is in line, the next bowler goes every fifteen seconds and the bot stays quiet.
It is a full-screen scene: put it on its own OBS scene for your break or downtime.
Don't have 10 followers yet? Don't worry, we'll substitute the followers you're missing up to 10 pins.

presets.label: Twilight
presets.blurb: Deep violet with pink highlights. The colors the game started out in.

presets.label: Nordic
presets.blurb: Night blue with yellow highlights. Cool and calm, with one warm color that stands out.

presets.label: Moss
presets.blurb: Dark forest green with lime highlights. Easy on the eyes for a long stream.

scenes.label: Bowl
scenes.blurb: One throw, exactly as the lane plays it. The outcome is random, so a few throws show a strike or a gutter too.
